<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Company" processRef="compliance-audit-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="compliance-audit-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_COMPANY" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>schedule</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>correct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_INTERNAL" name="Internal teams">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>prepare</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gather</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>selfAssess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_AUDITORS" name="Auditors">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>identify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gapGateway</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>finalAudit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>criteriaGateway</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>award</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>issue</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>withheld</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Compliance audit scheduled" />
    <bpmn:task id="schedule" name="Schedule the compliance audit" />
    <bpmn:task id="prepare" name="Prepare the documentation" />
    <bpmn:task id="gather" name="Gather the evidence" />
    <bpmn:task id="selfAssess" name="Conduct the self-assessment" />
    <bpmn:task id="review" name="Review the company processes" />
    <bpmn:task id="identify" name="Identify the gaps or issues" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gapGateway" name="Gaps or issues found?" />
    <bpmn:task id="correct" name="Make the necessary corrections or improvements" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge" />
    <bpmn:task id="finalAudit" name="Undergo the final audit" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="criteriaGateway" name="All criteria met?" />
    <bpmn:task id="award" name="Award the certification" />
    <bpmn:task id="issue" name="Issue the official documents" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="concluded" name="Process concluded" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="withheld" name="Certification withheld" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="schedule" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="schedule" targetRef="prepare" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="prepare" targetRef="gather" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="gather" targetRef="selfAssess" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="selfAssess" targetRef="review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="review" targetRef="identify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="identify" targetRef="gapGateway" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="yes" sourceRef="gapGateway" targetRef="correct" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" name="no" sourceRef="gapGateway" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="correct" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="merge" targetRef="finalAudit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="finalAudit" targetRef="criteriaGateway" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="yes" sourceRef="criteriaGateway" targetRef="award" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" name="no" sourceRef="criteriaGateway" targetRef="withheld" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="award" targetRef="issue" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="issue" targetRef="concluded" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
